headline: EPS holds above last year despite sequential drop
summary_short: Wakou Shokuhin reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥80.06, up 10.6% y/y from ¥72.38.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥80.06 rose 10.6% year-over-year from ¥72.38, but fell 56.8% sequentially from ¥185.47 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
